source_issues.evidence: schema 中 TXT/SRV/HTTPS 变体 required 含 name 但 properties 未声明，additionalProperties=false，jsonschema 复现显示 {"type":"TXT","name":"","value":"x"} 与 {"type":"TXT","value":"x"} 均 INVALID；严格 spec 驱动的客户端和本 SDK 用户无法创建 TXT、SRV、HTTPS 记录，而 TXT 记录是域名验证（Google、Microsoft 等）所必需。

signals.topic: Stale or wrong cache hits silently replay incorrect build outputs
signals.summary: Turborepo's task caching produces cache hits that replay outputs built from different source files, silently returning wrong artifacts under a green run. Multiple distinct root causes produce this: caching a dependant of a failed task under its normal hash, editing a local directory dependency outside workspace globs (npm file:, pnpm link:) not re-keying, treating a literal `[id]` route as a glob character class, caching a partial `.turbo-restore-*` temp file left by a killed restore, caching output under the old hash when an input is edited mid-run, restoring a remote-cache artifact that belongs to another hash, hashing symlinked inputs by link target rather than content, and tracking committed files under `outputs` producing a stale hit. With a remote cache, the poisoned artifact is distributed to every developer/CI machine, and reverting edits replays the erroneous output.
signals.review_reason: These issues cause turbo to report a green success while silently replaying build outputs that were built from different or partially-written source files. Users on the receiving end get wrong artifacts in their build products, published packages, or CI results with no error to alert them, and a remote cache spreads the corruption to every machine. This is a main-flow correctness break: no failure is surfaced and the wrong binary/output is shipped.

source_issues.title: With --continue=always, a dependant of a failed task is cached, and the next run replays output built from the failed task's partial files
source_issues.evidence: app runs against lib's partial/broken output, is saved under its normal hash, and on the next green run reports a cache hit replaying the broken bytes; with a remote cache that output reaches every machine. This is silent wrong-output under a successful run.

source_issues.title: Editing a local directory dependency outside the workspaces (npm file:, pnpm link:) gives a stale cache hit
source_issues.evidence: Editing vendor/dep/index.js keeps the same task hash; turbo reports a cache hit and replays output built from the old dep. User-visible: build output is stale without any warning.

source_issues.title: An input path with a literal [id] directory (Next.js route) is read as a character class, so edits to it give a stale cache hit
source_issues.evidence: Editing the real src/[id]/page.js yields a cache hit and replays old output while editing an unrelated src/i/page.js re-runs; breaks the common Next.js dynamic-route layout.

source_issues.title: A cache restore killed mid-file leaves a partial .turbo-restore-* file in the outputs, and the next cache miss caches it
source_issues.evidence: A killed restore drops a 16MB partial .turbo-restore-* file that the next cache miss packs into the artifact; every machine restoring that hash then gets the partial file in anything built/published from out/

source_issues.title: An input edited while its task runs is cached under the old hash, so reverting the edit replays the newer output
source_issues.evidence: Output is saved under the pre-edit hash; undoing/checking out the file triggers a silent cache hit replaying output built from different source, reaching every machine via remote cache.

signals.topic: turbo or its child task never exits, hanging CI jobs indefinitely
signals.summary: In several scenarios the turborepo process or its spawned task fails to terminate, leaving CI jobs hung until the runner force-kills everything. Concretely: on Windows `turbo run --dry=json` finishes and writes its complete answer but turbo.exe never exits; without a TTY, SIGINT never force-kills a task that ignores signals so turbo waits forever; on SIGHUP turbo exits but orphans the still-running task whose cleanup trap never runs; and a persistent task hangs after Ctrl+C when pnpm is installed via the npm pnpm.cmd shim on Windows. In CI a cancelled job hangs until the runner kills it, stalling pipelines.
signals.review_reason: Users running turborepo in CI or terminal sessions experience jobs that never terminate: turbo.exe hangs on Windows, cancelled jobs hang because SIGINT is never escalated to SIGKILL, SIGHUP orphans child tasks, and persistent tasks jam after Ctrl+C. Each stalls an entire pipeline until an external timeout force-kills the processes, costing CI minutes and leaving tasks/resources running unexpectedly.

source_issues.title: turbo 2.11.7 on Windows sometimes does not exit after turbo run --dry=json has printed its complete answer
source_issues.evidence: turbo.exe writes its full 1.5-2MB JSON answer then never exits, killed after 30s; reproduced several times per day and on pre-push gates, with and without telemetry.

source_issues.title: Without a TTY, SIGINT never stops a task that ignores it: turbo waits forever and never force-kills
source_issues.evidence: After two SIGINTs turbo is still running 408s later and the task keeps running because there is no force-kill escalation; in CI (no TTY) a cancelled job hangs until the runner kills everything.

source_issues.title: On SIGHUP, turbo exits but leaves the running task alive, and the task's cleanup never runs
source_issues.evidence: A SIGHUP (closed terminal/SSH) makes turbo exit but the task is orphaned and its cleanup trap never runs; processes outlive turbo.

source_issues.title: Windows: persistent task hangs after Ctrl+C when pnpm is installed with npm (pnpm.cmd shim)
source_issues.evidence: A persistent task hangs after Ctrl+C on Windows when pnpm is installed through the pnpm.cmd shim, leaving the job stuck.

signals.topic: turbo prune produces a pnpm lockfile that breaks frozen installs
signals.summary: When the pnpm lockfile is a multi-document YAML (written when a project pins packageManager under pnpm 12 packageManagerDependencies), turbo prune drops every settings key except autoInstallPeers and excludeLinksFromLockfile. The pruned output then fails `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH because settings like autoDedupe/dedupeInjectedDeps no longer match, blocking CI and deployment builds after pruning. The single-document fix (#14423) did not reach the multi-document path and it reproduces in 2.11.7–2.11.9.
signals.review_reason: The prune output is unusable: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` hard-fails with a config mismatch, which blocks the standard install step in CI and deployment after a prune. The user is stuck with a broken pruned output and no obvious workaround, reproduces across three released versions.

source_issues.title: turbo prune drops pnpm lockfile settings when the lockfile is multi-document (pnpm 12 packageManagerDependencies)
source_issues.evidence: Pruned lockfile loses autoDedupe/dedupeInjectedDeps etc., and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile on the pruned output fails with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH; the install cannot proceed.

signals.topic: turbo boundaries/query fail to parse JSX in .js files
signals.summary: `turbo boundaries` and `turbo query` file tracing cannot parse a `.js` file that contains JSX: `turbo boundaries` reports 'failed to parse file ... parser panicked' and `turbo query` returns no dependencies plus 'Unexpected JSX expression'. The same content in a `.jsx` file traces correctly. The regression was introduced when the SWC parser was replaced with oxc (which enables JSX only for .jsx files), so commons-style JSX-in-.js files break the boundaries check and stashes dependencies in turbo query.
signals.review_reason: A real regression that makes the boundaries linter hard-fail and the query file-tracer miss dependencies for any project using JSX-in-.js (a common Babel-era JavaScript style). The command errors out and inaccurately reports issues or omits imports, undermining both features for affected projects, though it is limited to one feature set.

source_issues.title: turbo boundaries and turbo query file tracing fail to parse JSX in .js files
source_issues.evidence: turbo boundaries fails with 'parser panicked' on a .js file containing JSX, and turbo query returns no dependencies; renaming the file to .jsx makes both succeed. Regression from SWC-to-oxc swap around 2.8.13-canary.11.

signals.topic: vercel build 在 Windows 上因创建 .func 目录符号链接 EPERM 而阻断部署流程
signals.summary: Windows 用户执行 vercel build --prod 时，多路由复用同一函数的 Next.js 16 App Router 应用在 .vercel/output 写入阶段创建 .func 目录符号链接因缺少开发者模式/管理员权限触发 EPERM，整个部署主流程阻断，且报错无修复指引。
signals.review_reason: 用户在 Windows 上执行 vercel build --prod 部署主流程被阻断：同一提交在 Linux CI 上可正常构建部署，但 Windows 无开发者模式下两路由解析到同一函数时，构建产物写入阶段创建 .func 目录符号链接触发 EPERM，且只在整个 Next.js 构建完成后报出裸 EPERM，无法指导用户如何修复（需开发者模式/管理员权限）。这是明确的本地部署阻断痛点，涉及大量 App Router 应用。

source_issues.title: `vercel build` fails on Windows without Developer Mode: EPERM creating deduplicated `.func` symlink (#11118 still reproduces)
source_issues.evidence: 同一提交在 Linux GitHub Actions runner 上可正常 build+deploy，但 Windows 无开发者模式下 vercel build --prod 因 fs.symlink 建 .func directory symlink 触发 EPERM -4048 失败；Next.js 16 的 _global-error.rsc 与 /foods/[slug] 复用同一函数即触发，报错只是裸 EPERM 无任何修复指引。

signals.topic: 自定义 installCommand 成功后又用镜像旧版 pnpm 二次安装导致构建失败
signals.summary: 同时配置自定义 installCommand 和 api/*.ts 函数的项目，构建会先成功执行自定义安装，随后 @vercel/node 又用镜像内置旧版 pnpm 12 二次安装，旧版 pnpm 无法解析新版 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 includeResolutionSettings 而报错，使本已配好依赖的构建失败。
signals.review_reason: 自定义 installCommand 成功且依赖已装好后，@vercel/node 又用镜像内置的旧版 pnpm 12 二次 install，因无法解析新版 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 includeResolutionSettings 直接令整个构建失败。用户即使把安装步骤配好、依赖全部就绪，构建仍被无法控制的二次安装破坏，是明确的构建主流程阻断。

source_issues.title: Builder runs a second install with the image's pnpm after a custom installCommand succeeds
source_issues.evidence: 项目自定义 installCommand 成功（Done in 2.3s using pnpm v12.13.0）后，构建日志显示@vercel/node 又运行 Image 内置 older pnpm 12 的二次 pnpm install，因旧版无法解析 includeResolutionSettings 报 Failed to parse pnpm-workspace.yaml 并退出码 1，导致整个 build 失败，尽管依赖已由自定义 install 装好。

signals.topic: vercel env pull 对 Encrypted 环境变量静默返回空字符串且无警告
signals.summary: 用户 vercel env pull 时，Production/Preview 上标记为 Encrypted/Sensitive 的变量返回空字符串但无任何错误或警告，非加密变量正常，生成的 .env 里变量看似存在实则为空，极易把空配置带入本地或 CI 运行。
signals.review_reason: vercel env pull 对 Production/Preview 上标记为 Encrypted/Sensitive 的变量静默返回空字符串且无任何错误或警告，env ls 也无法区分两种变量，用户极易误以为拉取成功，从而在本地或 CI 使用空凭据导致关键功能不可用或难以排查，属于关键配置静默丢失的痛点。

source_issues.title: vercel env pull returns empty strings for "Encrypted" variables on Production/Preview, with no warning
source_issues.evidence: vercel env pull .env.local --environment=production --yes 对 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 等 Encrypted 变量返回空字符串，无错误无提示，变量看似已定义但为空；NEXT_PUBLIC_* 与系统 VERCEL_* 变量则正常拉取；env ls 显示的 'Encrypted' 无法区分 Sensitive 与非 Sensitive，用户无法得知空值原因。

signals.topic: @vercel/connect OAuth 授权失败被吞掉错误细节，用户反复登录仍失败且不可诊断
signals.summary: eve 适配器 completeAuthorization 忽略 eve 传回的 callback 错误参数，并把失败翻译为固定文案、丢弃 Connect 错误码，导致用户连续 5 次完成 OAuth 登录仍无授权且日志无法诊断根因，retryable 默认 true 造成反复重试无效登录。
signals.review_reason: 生产环境用户完成 OAuth 登录 5 次后 Connect 仍无授权授权，但 completeAuthorization 忽略 eve 传入的 callback 错误参数，并把失败翻译成固定文案、丢弃 Connect 的错误码/status/vendor；日志无法区分 user_authorization_required 与 no_token，无法判断是 provider 拒绝还是 token 交换失败，且 retryable 默认 true 导致 eve 反复要求用户重复根本不能成功的登录。这是授权接入反复失败且不可诊断的明显痛点。

source_issues.title: [connect] `@vercel/connect/eve`: `completeAuthorization` ignores `callback` and hides Connect's error code
source_issues.evidence: eve 适配器 completeAuthorization 未解构 callback 导致 provider 返回的 error 参数被忽略；translate 将失败替换为固定文本 'Authorization did not complete...'，丢弃 code/status/vendor 且不设 reason 与 cause；生产用户完成登录 5 次仍无 grant，日志只见固定句无法定位根因，retryable 默认 true 使 eve 反复要求重复登录。

signals.topic: @vercel/queue push 模式重复投递时自动 ack 记录误导性 MessageNotFoundError 日志
signals.summary: push 模式消费者每次收到 at-least-once 重复投递，SDK 在 handler 成功返回后对第二次投递自动 ack 会触发 MessageNotFoundError，无法从应用代码捕获，误导性错误日志与真实结算失败日志无法区分。
signals.review_reason: push 模式 handleCallback 消费者在 at-least-once 重复投递时，handler 成功后 SDK 自动结算第二次投递触发 AcknowledgeMessage 404 MessageNotFoundError。该错误发生在 handler 成功之后、从应用代码无法捕获或抑制，且与真实结算失败的错误日志无法区分，迫使运维每次重复投递都需取证证明告警无害。属于反复出现的误导性错误日志与运维排障负担。

source_issues.title: handleCallback auto-ack logs MessageNotFoundError after successful handler completion on at-least-once redelivery
source_issues.evidence: @vercel/queue 0.4.0（0.3.x 亦可复现）push 模式，收到 at-least-once 重复投递时第一次自动 ack 成功移除消息后，第二次投递的自动 ack 触发 404 MessageNotFoundError；发生在 handler 已成功返回后，应用无法拦截，与真实结算失败难以区分，仅有的规避方式是放弃 push 改用 poll 模式手工 AcknowledgeMessage。
